cause_quote: The introducing diff registered `kind: "session:report"` and rendered it through `return staticHtml`<${tag} .widget=${widget} .session=${this.session} .active=${this.active}></${tag}>`;`, placing the new report inside the existing fixed-height, scrollable widget body.
user_saw: On a phone, tall reports and session progress cards showed only part of their content, and swiping over them scrolled the card instead of the dashboard.
summary: The fix lets native reports and session progress cards grow to fit their content on phones while preserving saved sizes as minimums and retaining desktop and embedded-widget sizing.
reasoning: The mobile stacking change predates native reports and kept each card's saved row span on a grid with fixed 56 px rows. I checked the report introduction and its board styles and confirmed that reports entered the existing `overflow: auto` widget body on day one, so tall reports already scrolled inside their cards before later rendering changes.
